suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 applies to unsafe deserialization of Kotlin build-cache metadata, and CVE-2020-29582 applies to compiler temporary-directory handling. The scanned runtimeClasspath artifacts are kotlin-stdlib and kotlin-reflect; neither reads build-cache metadata nor invokes the compiler. Remove this bounded suppression when Kotlin 2.4.20 is available as a stable release compatible with the supported Spring Boot 3.5 line.
